summary: Learn to design, facilitate, and report workshops with POP, RACI, and digital tools. Build clearer sessions and stronger outcomes.
lede: Facilitation Skills for Workshops and Strategy Sessions gives you practical methods to design purposeful sessions, guide participation, and manage group dynamics. You will learn to shape agendas, align stakeholders, and turn discussion into decisions, documented outputs, and actionable next steps. The course helps you build a repeatable approach for working through competing priorities, senior voices, hybrid attendance, and limited time. Through exercises and simulations, you will practice tools such as the POP framework, Kaner’s Diamond, RACI matrices, stakeholder mapping, decision logs, action plans, and visual capture.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly facilitate discussions, run planning sessions, or support decision-making across teams.
audience: Operations Manager using facilitation to improve process
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in meetings, workshops, project coordination, or team leadership. Familiarity with basic project documents such as agendas, action logs, or slide decks is helpful, and no coding is required. The course introduces advanced facilitation concepts at an operational level, with hands-on practice in workshop design, decision capture, and strategy session delivery.
